description: This file defines structures and functions for backtracing on the Xtensa architecture within the Zephyr project, including obtaining and iterating over stack frames for debugging purposes.

methods.name: xtensa_backtrace_get_start
methods.description: Initializes backtrace by retrieving the first stack frame's PC, SP, and caller's PC.

methods.name: xtensa_backtrace_get_next_frame
methods.description: Iteratively retrieves the next stack frame in the backtrace.

methods.name: xtensa_backtrace_print
methods.description: Prints the current stack backtrace up to a specified depth.
